He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Georgia Bulldogs men's basketball|Georgia Bulldogs]]. ==Early life and high school== Newell was born in [[Atlanta]], and grew up in [[Athens, Georgia]] before his family moved to [[Destin, Florida]] when he was ten years old.{{cite web|url=https://uga.rivals.com/news/five-star-asa-newell-s-life-and-career-come-full-circle-in-athens|title=Five-star Asa Newell's life and career comes full circle in Athens|first=Anthony|last=Dasher|website=[[Rivals.com]]|access-date=November 13, 2023}}{{Cite web |date=2023-10-25 |title=Georgia, White land five-star forward Newell |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/38743692/georgia-mike-white-land-5-star-forward-asa-newell |access-date=2025-01-17 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} He initially attended [[Choctawhatchee High School]] in [[Fort Walton Beach, Florida]]. Newell averaged 14.7 points and 8.7 rebounds per game and was named the area Player of the Year by the ''[[Northwest Florida Daily News]]'' as a sophomore.{{cite web|url=https://www.nwfdailynews.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2022/07/30/daily-news-basketball-all-area-newell-sanders-jeadline-poy-coy-honorsdaily-news-basketball-all-area/10102095002/|title=Daily News Boys Basketball All-Area: Newell, Sanders headline POY/COY honors|work=[[Northwest Florida Daily News]]|date=July 30, 2022|access-date=November 13, 2023}} Newell transferred to [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde, Florida]] prior to the start of his junior year.{{cite web|url=https://www.onlineathens.com/story/sports/college/bulldogs-extra/2023/11/09/asa-newell-georgia-basketball-college-basketball-recruiting-sec-basketball/71515275007/|title=Here's what Mike White said about Georgia basketball 5-star Asa Newell|work=[[Athens Banner-Herald]]|date=November 9, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}} ===Recruiting=== Newell is a consensus five-star recruit and one of the top players in the 2024 class, according to major recruiting services.{{cite web|url=https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2023/jul/25/asa-newell-class-of-2024s-top-ranked-power-forward/|title=Asa Newell, class of 2024's top-ranked power forward, on campus for Gonzaga visit|work=[[The Spokesman-Review]]|date=July 25, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}} He committed to play college basketball
